text: Natural language processing lets predictive systems handle specialized legal terminology and competing interpretations, but it still cannot capture the emotive and cognitive nuances of legal reasoning.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Morgan A. Gray, The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5541658

isBasedOn.name: The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law

abstract: NLP enables predictive systems to handle the specialized terminology and multiple interpretations inherent in legal systems, though challenges remain in capturing emotive-cognitive nuances.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: NLP applied to unstructured legal texts
